environment.dataVolume: 500 documents (254 issue / 91 wiki / 35 sprint / 32 weekly_plan / 27 weekly_retro / 20 person / 15 project / 15 weekly_review / 6 standup / 5 program), 20 users — verified via SELECT before benchmarking, byte-identical to baseline (deterministic seed-augment.ts, fixed LCG/epoch)
scaffolding: Isolated worktree Ship-wt-api_compare, branch measure/api-perf-compare-jul30 at main 15e6cb0.
Exclusive database ship_wt_api_compare on the same ship-audit-pg (postgres:15-alpine, :5433) container baseline used; already fully migrated (schema_migrations=44) before seeding.
pnpm db:seed then ./api/node_modules/.bin/tsx audit/seed-augment.ts, verified row counts match baseline exactly (500/20).
Installed autocannon@8.0.0 into this session's scratchpad node_modules (not the repo), same version as baseline.

API server: tsx watch src/index.ts (api/.env.local sets NODE_ENV=development, PORT=3211) — resolveApiRateLimits() treats 'development' and baseline's unset NODE_ENV identically (isDevEnv = NODE_ENV !== 'production' in both cases); empirically confirmed via response headers: RateLimit-Limit: 1000 (matches baseline's dev ceiling exactly).
PostgreSQL query logging confirmed OFF (log_statement=none, log_min_duration_statement=-1) before measuring.

bench-runner.mjs reused UNCHANGED in methodology; a copy (bench-runner-compare.mjs, in raw/) was necessary because the original hardcodes a prior session's scratchpad path, the main worktree's OUT dir, API port 3001, and a baseline-only document id — none resolve in this worktree (API_PORT=3211 per .factory-env, different DATABASE_URL). Diff against the original shows only those 4 constants changed; the burst/window-sync/percentile logic is byte-identical.

One discard-and-retry occurred on the first combination (documents-wiki c=10, attempt 1: 31x 429) — caused by this session's own pre-flight curl verification calls consuming rate-limit budget in that window, not by the runner or the app. Attempt 2 was 100% 2xx (900/900), matching baseline's own documented discard/retry protocol.
A supplementary re-run of documents-byid only (bench-runner-byid-recheck.mjs) was performed after the primary run to check an inconsistent result at c=25; recorded separately as _byid_recheck.json.

Full test suite (pnpm test: api vitest + web vitest) run after benchmarking completed: 55 API files/662 tests + 49 web files/420 tests, all passed. Running the API suite truncates this worktree's exclusive database by design (documented in api/.env.local) — this happened only after all benchmark JSON artifacts were already written to disk.
environment.serverMode: development — api/.env.local sets NODE_ENV=development explicitly (baseline had it unset); both resolve to isDevEnv=true in resolveApiRateLimits(), giving an identical 1000 req/min per-identity rate limit. Verified empirically, not just by reading the code.
environment.backgroundLoad: load average 2.2-6.2 (14 cores) during the run; six-plus sibling worktree API dev servers were present but idle (0% CPU in ps) for other in-flight factory tickets, plus assorted unrelated Docker containers and VS Code processes. Not fully quiet in the sense of 'nothing else running,' but no other benchmark, test suite, or active traffic ran concurrently with the bursts.
environment.tool: autocannon 8.0.0 (identical to baseline; per-response latencies collected via the instance response event)
environment.databaseServer: PostgreSQL 15-alpine in Docker (ship-audit-pg) on :5433; pg Pool max 10 (dev) — same container, same version as baseline

metrics.response_compression_encoding_negotiated: br (client Accept-Encoding: gzip,deflate,br) / gzip (client Accept-Encoding: gzip only)
metrics.compression_not_exercised_by_autocannon_: autocannon sends no Accept-Encoding header; meanBytesPerResponse in every burst (e.g. 38979 for documents-wiki) matches the uncompressed body, not the gzip/br wire size — confirms the P95 latency comparisons above are NOT confounded by compression CPU, consistent with API-3's own prediction that this fix is invisible to a loopback latency benchmark.
metrics.ratelimit_429_seen: 31 (single discard on first attempt only, self-inflicted by pre-flight curl checks; every accepted measurement was 100% 2xx)

verdict.target: >=20% P95 reduction on at least 2 endpoints, identical conditions

across_all_tested_concurrencies.GET /api/issues: clears >=20% at c=10 (-31.27%), c=25 (-30.68%), c=50 (-39.42%) — robust at every concurrency tested
across_all_tested_concurrencies.GET /api/documents/:id: clears >=20% only at c=50, reproduced across two independent runs (-34.75% primary, -56.6% recheck); flat at c=10 (~-4 to -5%); WORSE at c=25 in both runs (+38.41% primary, +10.38% recheck) — reproducible regression, not resolved as noise

verdict.caveat: The category's own headline framing (P95 at c=25, matching baseline.md) is cleared by only 1 of 6 endpoints. A second endpoint (documents/:id) clears the bar robustly but only at c=50, and is measurably worse than baseline at c=25 in two independent measurements — this is reported as-is rather than resolved in either direction, since the root cause for the c=25-specific regression was not isolated (see after-phase2-jul30.md).
